summary: Iteration 4: tested the Gemini AI features (backend + frontend, mobile 390x844). New suite test_ai_api.py passed 9/9. Assistant results: guests get 401 and an empty message gets 422. The SSE stream sends delta events and then a done event with a draft; the <<<BOZZA>>> separator never leaks into the text. Free text gave an item/event draft with start_date 2026-10-23 and start_time 22:00. In the same session, 'cambia orario alle 23' changed only start_time to 23:00, and ai_chats stored 4 messages. A passaggi text gave a post draft with from/to/date/time/seats/contribution and the 'Offro passaggio' tag. A real JPEG poster uploaded via /api/upload was read correctly (title 'Jazz Night Potenza', date 2026-10-24, time 21:30, price 10€, Teatro Stabile) and fields.image_url equals the uploaded url. A link message was handled without errors. Moderation results: a harmless passaggi post got ai_review low and stayed approved. A high-risk unisciti post got ai_review high and was moved to pending with ai_held=true, and it shows up in /admin/pending with ai_review. A submitted item got its review within the wait time. POST /admin/ai/moderate/item/{id} returned a review, and guests/non-admins got 401. Frontend: guest + shows the login prompt. Logged-in user flow worked end to end: + -> add-ai-button -> chat with streaming reply -> ai-draft-card -> ai-use-draft fills the form (title, category 'DJ Set / Discoteca', town, zone, date, time, address, price, description) -> add-submit-button -> success. Poster upload through ai-attach-button/ai-file-input showed the preview, produced a correct draft, and the form had the image preview set. Admin: the Coda tab shows ai-review-{id} badges (ok / a rischio / analisi in corso) and ai-analyze-{id} buttons; re-analysis was confirmed in the DB (review timestamp updated). AdminEditor (admin-new-button -> add-ai-button -> Lucy -> admin-editor-save) published immediately with the toast 'Pubblicato subito ✅'. Regression: test_v2_api + test_vivi_api passed 35/35, and the /vivi page, Bacheca and the manual + flow (unisciti published) work. No JS page errors. About 13 LLM calls in total.

minor.issue: SSRF filter only checks the hostname string with a regex. It can be bypassed: 'http://user@127.0.0.1/' passes because the userinfo becomes the host, so does hex 'http://0x7f.0.0.1/', and so does 'metadata.google.internal'. DNS names that resolve to private IPs pass, and follow_redirects=True lets a public URL redirect to an internal one. Suggested fix: parse with urllib.parse, resolve the host (socket.getaddrinfo) and reject private/loopback/link-local IPs with the ipaddress module, then re-check after each redirect (or set follow_redirects=False and handle redirects manually).

image_url accepts any '/api/files/<path>', so a user can make Lucy read any stored object path (low risk). Also, image_b64 does not pass the mime type, so PNG/WEBP are sent without an explicit type. The JPEG test worked.

The LLM lists optional fields as missing (e.g. 'Da completare: instagram, info_link, image_url' for a complete event). Suggested fix: filter missing on the backend to the required fields only (title, start_date for dated kinds, required section fields).

ui_bugs.issue: Race: right after page load with a valid token, tapping + before /auth/me finishes shows the guest login prompt. This happened in the first test run. Treat 'auth not ready' as loading instead of guest.

issues: The placeholder 'Incolla un link o descrivi l'evento…' wraps to 2 lines inside the rows=1 textarea on 390px, so the top line is clipped. Shorten it (e.g. 'Link, testo o locandina…') or use whitespace-nowrap/text-ellipsis.
Once Lucy is open in the admin editor there is no 'Scegli a mano' back button (AddSheet has ai-back-button).
'Cambia tipo' returns to a fresh Lucy chat (AiAssistant remounts), so the conversation and draft are lost. Consider keeping the AiAssistant state or returning to the picker.
Date/time fields use the native browser pickers (type=date/time) instead of a shadcn calendar; this existed before.

action_items: (security, medium) Harden safe_host/fetch_link/image_b64 against SSRF: resolve DNS, use an ipaddress private/loopback check, strip userinfo, re-validate redirects
(minor) Filter draft.missing on the backend to required fields only
(minor) Fix the clipped AI textarea placeholder at 390px
(minor) Avoid the guest prompt on + while auth is still loading
(optional) Add a back button in AdminEditor AI mode and keep the Lucy chat state when using 'Cambia tipo'
critical_code_review_comments: ai_moderate puts a post on hold (status pending) only if the status was approved. When an admin later approves an ai_held post, ai_held is not cleared. If the owner then edits the post, moderation runs again and can put it back on hold, which is acceptable but undocumented.

ai_moderate falls back to risk 'medium' when the JSON cannot be parsed. Silent failures (exceptions) return None and leave no ai_review, so the badge says 'analisi in corso' forever. Consider storing an error state.

fetch_link calls run one after another inside the request before streaming starts (up to 2 links x 8s plus the og:image fetch at 10s), so the user may wait about 20s without feedback. Send an initial SSE event first.
AI_TASKS fire-and-forget tasks are lost on restart (hot reload), so items/posts created just before a restart never get a review. An admin can re-run it manually.
server.py is now about 1970 lines; split AI into its own module (ai.py).
seed_data_creation: None kept. The TEST_ai* users, their posts/items/ai_chats, the admin TEST_AI item and the admin Lucy session were deleted. A pre-existing pending spotted post by 'modtest_u1', the item 'Cc' and one ai_chat from another user were left untouched (not created by this test).
